findings.summary: A workflow with both a quoted "on" key and an unquoted on key reads as two keys in PyYAML, so the trigger rule can miss the second trigger list.
The plan workflow test accepts a step that copies the plan file elsewhere.
The plan workflow test accepts terraform_wrapper set to true, which would make the setup action echo command output.
A terraform command spelled with an empty quote pair inside the word is not recognised as a terraform command by the test.
A failed terraform show prints two fixed lines rather than one.
Very deeply nested plan JSON makes the check script raise a traceback, and its standard error is not discarded, so script line numbers could reach the public log.
The job summary cannot be read over the REST API, so its content in live runs rests only on the script's own tests.
A failure inside the AWS credentials action prints that action's own error text, which the fixed-message rule does not cover.
With the in-run log check removed, nothing checks the public plan log for a role unique ID until follow-up 307, and masking works only while the secret holds the current role's ID.
The approved issue body still says no masking step is used; the human's ruling recorded in the decision record overrides it.
The issue's replay criterion names a fixed count of five workflows, which went stale as main gained workflow files.
The weakened-test check cannot see tests deleted from a file that is new relative to the base, so the removed log-check tests needed a review by hand.
The add-mask command masks only the first line of a multi-line value; a role unique ID has one line, so this matters only if the secret is set wrongly.
The state bucket variable is expanded into the script text instead of being passed through an environment variable.
The checkout step keeps its default of persisting the read token in git config while branch code runs, as the terraform check workflow also does.
The first addendum of the decision record says the one-job shape no longer holds, while the second addendum returns the workflow to one job.
The earlier dated session summary for this issue still lists the missing secret in the setup docs as open, after it was fixed; summaries are records and are not edited.
The check script refuses a plan with no resources at all, which is fine for the server part but would block an empty configuration.
Issue 281 merged a change to the server Terraform with no re-apply step, so main drifted from the account and a plan of an unchanged pull request showed one change until the human applied it.
The plan step prints only a fixed message, so a denied read has to be found by hand; the human suggested printing only the denied action's name, which is not secret.
One Engineer launch edited files with Python heredoc scripts instead of the edit tool, against the command-shape rule; the resulting diff was reviewed and approved as shown.
Pull request 263 was marked ready for review by someone outside the lane before either QA launch had passed.
